verdict.rationale: Baseten has its own CLI commands (`truss push`, `baseten model push`, one-command checkpoint deploys) and programmatic APIs, which points to scriptable, non-interactive use. Nothing in the evidence explicitly covers CI pipelines, headless authentication, or non-interactive flags, so the automation story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration (e.g. GitHub Actions examples), headless/non-interactive auth guidance for the CLI, and independent corroboration of CI usage.
